name: OpenClaw
description: Self-hosted personal agent with tools and skills. Runs as a local terminal chat (openclaw chat - no gateway service) against an openai-style provider through the hotbed proxy. Needs Node 24 (provisioned on install).

proxy.setup: f="$HOME/.config/hotbed/agents/openclaw/proxy.json5"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; openclaw config patch --file "$f" >/dev/null && openclaw config validate >/dev/null
